'''Glirin''' was the surname of a family of marsh farmers on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Lobaoc]]. Their daughter was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], and taken by [[Ambaln]] to be his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] for training in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].
